idea.title: Show HN: Ktx – Open-source executable context layer for data agents

plan.tagline: CLI tool that creates persistent context layers for AI agents using local SQLite
plan.problem: AI agents lose conversation history between sessions, requiring manual context reconstruction which breaks workflows for indie devs and small businesses
plan.solution: Stores agent interactions in a local SQLite database with CLI commands to add, list, and retrieve context layers, enabling seamless agent continuity
plan.target_market: Solo Python developers, indie hackers, and small business owners who build or use AI agents but lack persistent context management
plan.demo_script: Run `ktx --demo` to see 3 hardcoded agent sessions with timestamps, topics, and summaries. Lists them with `ktx list` and retrieves context via `ktx get 1`. No internet required.
plan.phuket_angle: Phuket-based travel agencies or tour operators could use Ktx to maintain persistent context layers for customer interactions, ensuring agents remember past inquiries about trips, preferences, and bookings across sessions without cloud dependencies.
